about:
Wilkins Lumber Co. Inc. operates a small family-owned sawmill in Milford, New Hampshire, a business that has been providing native wood products to the Souhegan Valley since 1808. The mill has survived the Great Depression, a fire, and a lightning strike in the early 1900s, remaining under family stewardship for over two centuries.

The company offers a log-to-lumber service that begins with selective harvesting for local timberland owners. Its sawmill processes New Hampshire hemlock and pine, turning every scrap into competitively priced lumber products. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Wilkins Lumber serves local timberland owners and regional buyers throughout Southern New Hampshire, supplying native lumber for construction, woodworking, and other wood-product applications. The mill’s customer base is rooted in the Souhegan Valley and surrounding communities.

The company attributes its longevity to dedication, perseverance, and hard work, emphasizing its commitment to continuing the supply of native wood into the 21st century. Its family-owned structure and historical resilience are presented as key differentiators.

name: Williams & Clark Custom Woodworking (WCCW, INC.)
old_description: At WCCW, we are passionate about crafting the finest custom millwork solutions for commercial spaces. With a rich history in woodworking and a commitment to excellence, we have been serving the needs of businesses across the greater North Texas area since 1988.
about:
Williams & Clark Custom Woodworking (WCCW, Inc.) has operated as a family-owned shop in Frisco, Texas since 1988. The business was founded to serve commercial construction projects across the greater North Texas region with custom millwork and cabinetry.

The company fabricates commercial cabinets, plastic laminate casework, and architectural millwork for ceilings, walls, and countertop surfaces. Work is performed in solid wood and various plastic laminates, built to client designs and specifications. The operation handles custom fabrication and installation for commercial interiors.

Clients span automotive, food service, entertainment, government, financial services, aviation, education, and healthcare sectors. Completed projects include Mercedes‑Benz corporate offices in Flower Mound, an In‑N‑Out Burger distribution center in Lancaster, the Toyota Music Factory concert venue in Irving, City of Dallas offices and courtroom, USAA corporate offices in Plano, the United Airlines United Club at DFW Airport, the University of North Texas Clark Hall renovation in Denton, and HCA Medical Center Women's Services in McKinney. The firm works with general contractors, owners, and property and facility management companies.

WCCW emphasizes a commitment to excellence and a passion for crafting custom millwork solutions. Testimonials highlight professionalism, quality of work, and competitive pricing as distinguishing factors.

name: Winkler Woods LLC
old_description: Since 2003, Jorma Winkler has specialized in producing Koa and other exotic wood veneers and lumber, primarily for furniture making. Our premium Koa veneers, sourced from Hawaii's Mauna Loa, are available as paper back and fleece back options. We also offer a variety of woods like Mango, Monkey Pod, and Albizia in veneer form.
about:
Winkler Woods LLC was established in 2002 in Honolulu, Hawaii by Jorma Winkler, a fourth-generation wood industry expert. The company began specializing in producing Koa and other exotic wood veneers and lumber, primarily for furniture making, starting in 2003.

The company produces premium Koa veneers sourced from Hawaii's Mauna Loa, available as paper-backed (KamiPLY) and fleece-backed (WashiPLY) options. They also offer veneers in Mango, Monkey Pod, and Albizia. Their hardwood lumber selection includes figured curly Koa, spalted Mango, and Monkey Pod. They supply tonewood sets for ukuleles (soprano, concert, tenor) and guitars (acoustic and electric). Operations include custom orders and wholesale distribution through dealers on Big Island and Maui. Minimum purchase is $1,500.

They serve musical instrument makers such as guitar and ukulele builders, furniture manufacturers, and woodworkers. Customers include both wholesale and retail markets globally, with distributors on the Big Island and Maui maintaining their own inventory.

Their stated mission is to manufacture Hawaiian and exotic tonewoods, veneers, and lumber that show the beauty of God's creation. Core values include integrity, honesty, hard work, family, and efficiency. A secondary mission aims to provide commercial benefit to forest landowners while maintaining ecological values through a scientific approach.

old_description: Wire and Cable Specialties, Inc. is a leading USA-based manufacturer of Stainless Steel and Nickel-Alloy wire and cable products, established in 1976. We specialize in making conventional and miniature-sized wire, strand and cable sold bare and/or nylon and vinyl coated.
about:
Wire & Cable Specialties, Inc. operates from Coatesville, Pennsylvania, where it was founded in 1976. The company remains a U.S.-based manufacturer of stainless steel and nickel-alloy wire and cable products.

The company produces conventional and miniature-sized wire, strand, and cable, sold bare or with nylon and vinyl coatings. Its product lines include safety lock wire for aviation, automotive, and industrial fastening; utility wire for home, workshop, and light utility applications; and picture hanging wire that is corrosion-resistant, soft, and flexible. The firm serves wholesale customers and emphasizes capacity for large-scale operations, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers span aviation, automotive, industrial, hobby and craft, jewelry, and recreational sport fishing sectors. The company positions itself as a wholesale partner offering volume discounts, priority fulfillment with consistent lead times, flexible payment terms, and dedicated support.

Wire & Cable Specialties highlights its "Made in USA" manufacturing and a focus on mission-critical performance. It was established to supply stainless steel and nickel-alloy wire and cable for demanding applications, and it differentiates itself through reliable order processing, customized terms, and direct industry expertise.

name: Wire Belt Company of America
old_description: Wire Belt Company offers many styles and specifications of conveyor belts to suit your specific application. We are also at the forefront of development and innovation in the conveyor sector. We have been manufacturing conveyors and conveyor belting since 1919 starting with our roots as the Greer Company which evolved into Wire Belt Company in 1947. Wire Belt Company supplies conveyor belts to industries as varied as food and beverage, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, electronics, environmental services and automotive.
about:
Wire Belt Company of America operates from Bedford, New Hampshire, tracing its origins to 1919 when the Greer Company began manufacturing conveyors and belting. The business adopted the Wire Belt name in 1947 and has continued as a manufacturer of metal conveyor belts and conveyor systems with a global distribution network.

The company produces a range of stainless-steel conveyor belts under product lines such as Eye-Flex®, Compact-Grid®, Flat-Flex®, Ladder-Track™, Versa-Link®, TC-327™, and Flex-Turn® conveyors. Its manufacturing covers custom belt design, fabrication, and assembly of complete conveyor systems for applications including heating, freezing, coating, and heavy product transport.

Wire Belt serves industries including food and beverage, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, electronics, environmental services, automotive, food processing, textiles, and agriculture. Customers range from global food processors to electronics manufacturers requiring precise product orientation and tight-space conveyance.

The company emphasizes on-time delivery, citing a rate above 99 percent to promised dates, and highlights direct customer service without automated phone systems. It also points to over a century of application knowledge and a global distribution network as key differentiators.

name: Wire Harness Manufacturing
old_description: established company providing contract assembly of cable assemblies/wire harnesses, and electromechanical assemblies. Our customers rely on us for small to large production volumes, with both short run and weekly production capabilities. Experienced personnel in our production, purchasing, inventory management, and engineering departments insure your product will be built to your specifications, on time, with quality assured. We specialize in providing services to companies needing expertise in developing a concept or prototype into a production ready product. If your product needs engineering development work, from prototypes to assembly, we can make it happen.
about:
Wire Harness Manufacturing operates from Lincoln, Nebraska, where it was founded in 1993. The company provides contract assembly of cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and electromechanical assemblies.

The shop handles small to large production volumes with both short-run and weekly production capabilities. In-house equipment includes cut-strip-crimp machines, wire cutting and stripping machines, crimp terminal presses, ultrasonic wire welding equipment, a milling machine for enclosure modifications, and an Artos CR22 automatic crimping wire processor. Services span cable and harness assemblies, ribbon cables, single-wire processing, kitting, hot stamping, heat-shrink labeling, loom and tubing cutting, thermal transfer printing, sonic wire welding, control-box enclosures, and thermal label printing. The company also offers engineering support from prototype through production, using CAD software for design and documentation.

Customers come from scientific equipment, automotive, original equipment manufacturers, transportation, environmental, and agricultural sectors. The firm specializes in helping companies develop concepts or prototypes into production-ready products, providing design, engineering, and vendor-relations expertise.

Wire Harness Manufacturing emphasizes 100% inspection before shipment using Cami Research and custom test fixtures, an experienced purchasing department that sources components for quality and lead time, and trained assemblers to eliminate learning-curve costs. The company says its CAD-driven workflow enables fast, accurate design changes and documentation.

about:

The company began as a residential and commercial electrical contracting firm serving the Reno–Lake Tahoe corridor, including Sparks, Verdi, Tahoe City, and Incline Village.

A 15,000‑square‑foot warehouse project is cited as one of the larger jobs completed.

Customers include high‑end custom‑home builders, property managers, real‑estate professionals, and commercial landlords. Testimonials reference a Tahoe luxury‑property agent, a custom‑home builder, and a residential remodel client who praised the crew’s cleanliness and reliability.

about:
Wire Wiz Electrician Services has operated from Egg Harbor Township, New Jersey since 1985. The company serves residential customers across the South Jersey shore region, including communities such as Atlantic City, Ocean City, Brigantine, and Galloway Township.

The firm provides a full range of residential electrical services, from lighting installation — recessed, kitchen, bathroom, basement, pendant, outdoor, and motion lighting — to electrical panel upgrades, meter socket replacement, service entrance cable replacement, and outlet repair. Additional offerings include knob-and-tube removal, ceiling fan and attic fan installation, bathroom exhaust fans, baseboard heating, programmable lighting control, digital thermostat installation, dimmer switches, and holiday lighting safety. The company also performs electrical home safety inspections.

Wire Wiz primarily serves homeowners in the coastal and inland towns of Atlantic and Cape May counties. Its service area spans Absecon, Atlantic City, Brigantine, Egg Harbor Township, Galloway Township, Linwood, Longport, Margate, Marmora, Mays Landing, Northfield, Ocean City, Pleasantville, Somers Point, and Ventnor.

The company highlights its 100% recommendation rating on HomeAdvisor, a Yelp recommendation, and seven Angie's List Super Service Awards earned since 2014. It emphasizes same-day and emergency response availability and advises customers against electricians who push service contracts, offering instead a monthly special discount service.

name: Wisconsin Metal Fab LLC
old_description: With the completion of our fifth facilities expansion in 2021, we’re perfectly situated to grow along with your contract manufacturing needs. Our 106,000 square foot facility is home to a full-service, start-to-finish custom fabrication shop that can create your prototype or production-quantity projects, on-time, and defect-free.
about:
Wisconsin Metal Fab LLC operates from Chippewa Falls, Wisconsin. The company completed its fifth facility expansion in 2021, bringing its manufacturing space to 106,000 square feet (a capabilities page also references 77,000 square feet). Ownership structure and founding year are not publicly disclosed.

The shop functions as a contract manufacturer and metal fabricator, producing custom components in carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum. Processes include CNC machining, precision laser and plasma cutting, turret punching, forming, robotic and manual welding, sawing, shearing, and project development, with in-house prefinishing, finishing, assembly, and transportation. The facility houses horizontal and vertical machining centers, horizontal mills, precision laser cutters, robotic welders, and CNC plasma cutters, and maintains a large on-hand inventory of sheet, plate, tube, and bar stock to support prototype through production runs.

Regular customers span oil production companies, large truck component manufacturers, railway maintenance operations, and water treatment facilities. A testimonial from Superior Diesel Inc. cites confidence in delivery, quality, and design support for new applications.

Wisconsin Metal Fab positions itself as a one-stop solution, emphasizing start-to-finish capability, CNC-controlled repeatability, and quick turnaround—most projects in two weeks or less—backed by ISO 9001 certification.
